episodes.title: Why Adding 10% to a $1,000 Invoice Does NOT Net $1,000 (Reverse Gross-Up Formula)
episodes.target_audience_question: How do I calculate the exact invoice amount to charge a client so I receive my exact target net payout after fees?
episodes.caption_with_link:
Adding +10% to a $1,000 invoice nets $990, not $1,000.

Exact Reverse Gross-Up Formula:
Required Gross = (Target Net + Fixed Fee) / (1 - Total Fee %)
For $1,000 net at 10% + $0.99 withdrawal: ($1,000 + $0.99) / 0.90 = $1,112.21.
